Name: Daily
$Comment: The main daily board: two ungated training contracts plus the weighted easy/normal/hard token faucet, rotating at UTC midnight. 'currencies' is the balance strip in the page header. Life essence is listed beside bounty tokens because a daily contract asks the player to spend essence, so both balances need to be visible while they pick a contract. List only what a player earns or spends at this board; an unlisted wallet simply does not appear.
